name: Medrite
tagline: Patient app and web portal for a New York urgent care: visits, lab results, OTP sign-in
role: App, web portal and backend by the Softwhere team for Medrite

scenes.title: Sign-in with a one-time code
scenes.body: Password first, then a 5-digit e-mail or SMS code that expires in five minutes.

scenes.title: Visits and tests in one place
scenes.body: The home screen lists recent visits and lab tests; the full history is grouped by month.

scenes.title: Lab results flagged at a glance
scenes.body: Abnormal values are flagged red, negative tests green; reports can be shared as a PDF.

scenes.title: Visit details and patient chart
scenes.body: Diagnoses with ICD-10 codes, the discharging provider and the patient's demographic summary.

scenes.title: Also on the web
scenes.body: A React patient portal served by the .NET API, with lab results ready to print.
